يستعروا (form VIII)
# يَسْتَعِرُوا (yastaʕirū) /jas.ta.ʕi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# يُسْتَعَرُوا (yustaʕarū) /jus.ta.ʕa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
